def: The context window itself: the current task, recent messages and tool results, fast and exact but lost when the run ends or the window is cleared.
Text the model writes inside its own window, such as a plan or to-do list, to organise a long task; it disappears with the window.
A file an agent writes outside its window, such as a progress log, so work can resume after a context reset or in a later session.
A tool whose file commands let a model read and write a memory directory, executed client-side by the application against storage it controls.
Records of what happened, such as past conversations and actions with their times, retrieved by search rather than loaded in full.
Facts that stay true until changed, such as a customer's preferred channel, stored with one current value per fact.
Stored knowledge of how to do recurring jobs, implemented in agents as skills, checklists or scripts.
A complete natural-language record of an agent's experiences from which relevant memories are retrieved by recency, importance and relevance.
Periodically synthesising stored memories into higher-level summaries that are stored and retrieved like any other memory.
Saving injected or false content into an agent's memory so that it persists and is trusted in later sessions.
A collection of reusable procedures, each described briefly, that an agent loads only when a task calls for them.
The file at the core of an Agent Skill, with YAML front matter giving a name and description followed by the instructions the agent reads when it chooses the skill.
A 2024 benchmark of 500 questions over long chat histories testing information extraction, multi-session and temporal reasoning, knowledge updates and abstention.
